verdict.rationale: Temporal ships a headless CLI (server start-dev, workers) usable in scripts/CI, Docker images for containerized pipelines, and a dedicated testing suite with time-skipping for automated integration/e2e tests — all runnable without a UI. Runtime probes confirm the CLI works standalone and docs are agent-legible. missing for 10: no explicit CI vendor integration examples (e.g. GitHub Actions recipe) or independent community confirmation of headless CI usage.
